description: Wind Turbines Geographical Zones - Grand Duchy of Luxembourg is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direction de l'Aviation Civile . Disclaimer The present data set, extracted from the Luxembourg Geoportail, is intended for geo-awareness and information purposes only. It affects geographical areas where operational considerations relating to civil aviation impact the planning, construction, and operation of wind turbines. The data set is updated on a yearly basis. Coverage: Direction de l'Aviation Civile . The publisher named on the listing is Direction de l'Aviation Civile . Its keywords include dac, wind-turbines, civil-aviation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
